# Demo fixture: the Brackenridge group (invented; public-demo safe)

Every file here is generated by the Rust fixture generator from the spec `world.json` beside it:

    cargo run -p xtask -- demo fixtures     # records, configs and goldens (this folder, ../cli, ../*.json)
    cargo run -p xtask -- demo states       # the frozen view states (../state/v0.10.2, ../state/v0.10.3)
    cargo run -p xtask -- demo check        # regenerate into a temp folder and compare byte for byte

The gate test `rust/xtask/tests/demo_regen.rs` runs the check, regenerates twice to prove the generator is
deterministic, and checks the collision rule: every amount in the specs has irregular cents (never .00 or
.50). There is no network access. Records go through the production `Writer` (append-only
tables, SHA-256 chain) with the clock pinned. The engine and CLI fixture (`../engine.json`: orgs `one`, `hq`
and `co`) comes from the same generator.

**Regression goldens.** `ic-*.json`, `parity-*.json` and `estimate-*.json` here, plus `../golden-*.json`,
`../ic-*.json` and `../compare-*.json`, are computed by the Rust core on the generated records. The CLI goldens
(`../cli/goldens/*.json`) are written by the Rust CLI: `OWNPURSE_BLESS=1 cargo test -p ownpurse-cli --test
cli_golden bless`. They are regression goldens: they pin today's behaviour, not parity with another runtime.

## The world

Brackenridge Lane Holdings owns three trading companies. All four orgs are US-dollar orgs with a calendar
fiscal year, on one group chart of four-digit codes: 1010 is every org's main operating account and 1060
its business card.

| alias | org | plan | type | short code | business |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `roast` | Tallowmere Coffee Roasting Co. | STANDARD | COMPANY | `!TmR4q` | wholesale coffee roaster |
| `hold` | Brackenridge Lane Holdings Ltd | PREMIUM | COMPANY | `!BkL7h` | the holding company |
| `design` | Quillfeather Design Consultancy LLP | STARTER | PARTNERSHIP | `!QfD2c` | brand and wayfinding design |
| `lab` | Saltmarsh Cupping Lab LLC | STARTER | COMPANY | `!SmC9l` | coffee quality (cupping) lab |
| `rhein` | Tallowmere Rösterei GmbH | — | — | `!TmRh5` | EUR, Organisation only (`record-ic.sqlite`) |

Groups: `all-co` (all four) and `ops` (roast, design, lab).

**Chart.** 10xx bank and card accounts, 14xx intra-group receivables, 15–16xx fixed and non-current assets,
22–28xx payables and finance, 24xx intra-group payables, 3010 capital, 3200 retained earnings, 4xxx income,
5xxx cost of sales, 6xxx overheads.

**Flows (2025 unless noted).**
- *Term loan with interest* (`hold-roast`, match both ways): Brackenridge lends Tallowmere 18,437.62 on
  11 Mar; Tallowmere repays 3,281.19 in July; Q3 interest of 412.37 is accrued by journal on both sides.
  The pair **matches**, with three matched entries.
- *Management fees* (`hold-design`): Brackenridge charges Quillfeather a fee by journal (1,906.33 in Nov 2024,
  then 2,764.18 in April and in August); Quillfeather remits one instalment in June. Quillfeather also pays
  the parent's annual-return filing, 418.27, against the fee balance, and Brackenridge never books it. The
  pair is **bridged** by that one item.
- *Supplier paid on another entity's behalf* (`design-roast`): Quillfeather pays Hollowpine Packaging Works
  1,148.63 for Tallowmere's bag-artwork proofs; Tallowmere books it by journal and settles in August. A
  reprint of 263.94 in November is on Quillfeather's side only: the **deliberate unexplained difference**.
- *Equipment advance* (`hold-lab`): Brackenridge advances Saltmarsh 6,912.48 for a sample roaster;
  Saltmarsh's exchange adjustment of 57.13 has no counterpart. The pair is **bridged**.
- *Normal trading*: wholesale bean sales, green-coffee purchases, afterburner servicing, cupping supplies,
  van fuel, design fees, typeface licences, an audit fee and a share subscription (Oct 2024).

Summary at 2025-12-31: **4 pairs · 1 matches · 2 bridged · 1 unexplained**. The intercompany variant
(`record-ic.sqlite`, `ownpurse-ic.json`) adds `design-roast-proofs` (unexplained residual 1,412.57) and
`roast-rhein` (not supported: different base currencies).

## Files

| File | What |
|---|---|
| `world.json` | the spec |
| `record.sqlite` | the main record ("all fresh") |
| `record-stale.sqlite` | lab last synced 2026-10-03 07:46 (2 days old, TTL 1 day → `stale`) |
| `record-never.sqlite` | lab has nothing in the record (`no local record`); one failed 503 call yesterday |
| `record-lowbudget.sqlite` | design at 62 calls left (below 10 % → red) |
| `record-noclose.sqlite` | roast has the opening TB (2024-12-31) but no cached TB at 2025-12-31: the year basis is "not compared" (acceptance C4) |
| `record-ic.sqlite`, `ownpurse-ic.json` | the intercompany variant (above) |
| `tenants.json` | alias → tenant id (synthetic UUIDs) |
| `ownpurse.json` | profile `demo` (store `record.sqlite`, token file `tokens/demo.json`, which is display only and never read by Rust; the four orgs; one profile-level `extra_links` entry), groups `all-co` and `ops`, `tui.log_rows` 300, parties, 4 pairs, account_map |
| `ic-2025-12-31.json`, `ic-variant-2025-12-31.json`, `parity-2025-12-31.json`, `estimate-2026-10-05.json` | regression goldens (above) |
| `classify.toml` | the demo classification catalog and rules (projects Harvest Blend launch, Wayfinding refit, Sample roaster programme, Cupping lab fit-out; bearers = the four orgs; the treatments of the spec; 11 rules, one archived; a `[tree]` that is validated, not executed) |
| `db/classify.sqlite` | the classification store over the 49 lines of `record.sqlite`, in mixed states: rule suggestions, human accepts and sets, an agent batch with a caption (`agent:claude`), notes, two groups, one undone write and two stale labels (38 open · 2 stale) |
| `classify-goldens/*.txt` | `ownpurse classify …` CLI goldens (argv, exit, stdout), run on a temp copy: `OWNPURSE_BLESS=1 cargo test -p ownpurse-cli --test classify bless` |

Pinned clock: `OWNPURSE_NOW=2026-10-05T09:46Z` (`snapshot::FIXTURE_NOW`). Every org synced at 07:46 UTC, so
ages read `2h`.

## Facts the acceptance checks rely on (record.sqlite, as of 2025-12-31)

- Calls left (the last `X-DayLimit-Remaining` reported today, UTC): roast **967** (33 calls), hold **978** (22),
  design **938** (62), lab **978** (22). The limit is 1,000. The header's calls-left figure in scope `all` is 938.
- Parity: the year basis matches Xero for every org. Full history differs on **roast 2** accounts and
  **design 15** accounts: setup balances that are in Xero's TB but in no document. hold and lab match on both
  bases.
- Compare (code alignment): 1010, 1060 and 3010 exist in several orgs under different names, so those
  merged rows carry `≠`. hold has no 1060, so it shows `—` there.
- Unicode: lab's card is `SALTMARSH SENSORY PANEL CARD™`, its supplier is the CJK contact `大阪焙煎研究所`,
  and one description has an emoji.
- http_log: today 07:43–07:45 UTC per org (2xx), one **404** (hold, attachments), one **429** (design, minute
  limit, no day-remaining header). Yesterday there was an identity login (`connect/token`, `connections`;
  tenant NULL) and one **503** (lab).
- Agent caption example: `Green-bean card spend, 2025 · 3 lines · 1,990.90` (roast's card account, 1060).
